description: Scores how much a recording sounds like a voice, with a speaker-embedding model: compare takes with a speaker's voice clip or with each other. It judges timbre and pitch range, not rhythm or emotion, and scores of different models can't be compared.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: The speaker-embedding model. ERes2NetV2 is the one speech synthesis papers report speaker similarity with; WeSpeaker was trained on other (English) data, so it is a cross-check. Scores of different models are not comparable.
